title: coryphantha cornuta
intro: Coryphantha cornuta, commonly known as the beehive cactus, is a species of cactus native to Mexico. It is a type of cactus that belongs to the Echinocereus genus and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The beehive cactus is said to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions such as pain relief and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Coryphantha cornuta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation.
